title: Visual Studio Code – versions
summary: This blog post documents Visual Studio Code release highlights from November 2026 back through November 2024, covering agent and AI features, development tools, and editor improvements across versions 1.96 through 1.146.
key_points: VS Code emphasizes agent-first development with features like inbox mode, multi-folder sessions, and delegated task execution
Copilot integration has evolved with harness options, model comparison, and model orchestration capabilities
AI features include image generation, computer use, voice mode, and various agent customization options
Development tools cover integrated browser functionality, MCP server support, and terminal enhancements
Security features include sandboxing, permission policies, and assisted tool approvals

quotes.text: Move to the Copilot harness before the Local harness is removed in February 2027.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates a deprecation timeline for developers to update their development environments

quotes.text: Let Copilot choose and orchestrate models, or compare models side by side.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes key AI capability for developers to leverage multiple language models in a single workflow

quotes.text: Let agents use desktop apps on your computer.
quotes.why_it_matters: Represents significant expansion of agent capabilities beyond code editing into system automation
